ledger.x: March 1848: Schleswig-Holstein rises against Denmark and forms a provisional government.
March 1848: Holstein passes to the rebels.
1848: the south of Schleswig joins the rising.
April 1848: Prussian troops cross the Dannevirke into Schleswig.
April 1851: the rebel army is disbanded.
April 1851: the provisional government's rule ends with the disbanding of its army; Holstein and Schleswig return to the Danish crown (the London Protocol of 8 May 1852 confirms the personal union).

wars.name: First Schleswig War
wars.outcome: A Danish victory, 'status quo ante bellum': the Treaty of Berlin of 2 July 1850 between Prussia and Denmark, Danish victory at Idstedt on 24-25 July 1850, the rebel army disbanded on 1 April 1851, and the London Protocol of 8 May 1852 kept the duchies joined…

certainty.note: A war-time front, not a boundary; the Cliopatria shape is used as drawn.
